integrity: All-size analytical proof accompanies an exact-rational, standalone finite checker. The finite checker alone is not a proof; scientific originality is a best-knowledge literature comparison, not independent certification.
limitations: Strictly independent binary votes and a prescribed alternating recruitment of one voter of each of two competence types. No optimality among other recruitment strategies, weighted rules, or strategic voting is claimed; historical priority is provisional.
title: A unique majority-accuracy trough under alternating independent expertise
